metadata.title: EnvCoRe-SW: a de-identified inventory and structured environmental measurement dataset derived from environmental compliance monitoring reports in Guizhou Province, Southwest China, 2018–2025
metadata.description: EnvCoRe-SW v5 (including the v5.5 follow-up corrections) is a de-identified report inventory and structured environmental measurement dataset derived from environmental compliance monitoring reports collected in Guizhou Province, Southwest China, during 2018–2025. The current analysis table contains 19,122 retained measurements after 1,392 cumulative exclusions from the pre-v5 20,514-record frame. The release includes completed 800-record stratified dual-human-review and 200-record targeted challenge QA results, correction audits, schema and validation documentation, figure source data, and a checksum manifest. Original reports, readable raw report text, organization/facility names, report numbers, source paths, and private crosswalks are excluded. The data are not intended for spatially explicit within-province analysis or regulatory determinations.
